description: This is a C# source code file defining an abstract base class `Snippet` for generating test code snippets within the PdfSharp.Quality namespace. It includes methods for rendering snippets as PDF or PNG, drawing headers, managing graphics boxes, and utility functions related to PDF creation. The class is designed to facilitate testing and demonstration of PDF rendering features with various drawing options.

classes.name: Snippet
classes.description: An abstract base class for code snippets used in testing PDF rendering, providing methods to render, draw headers, manage boxes, and utility functions for visual elements.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented in derived classes to render the specific snippet content on the provided XGraphics object.

methods.name: RenderSnippetAsPdf
methods.description: Renders the snippet as a PDF document with default width, height, graphics unit, and page direction.

methods.name: RenderSnippetAsPdf
methods.description: Renders the snippet as a PDF with specified width, height, graphics unit, and page direction.

methods.name: RenderSnippetAsPng
methods.description: Renders the snippet as a PNG image (skipped in certain build configurations).

methods.name: CreatePdfPage
methods.description: Creates and returns a new PDF page within the provided PDF document with preset dimensions.

methods.name: BeginBox
methods.description: Sets up the graphics context to start drawing inside a box with specified options and description.

methods.name: EndBox
methods.description: Ends the current box drawing, restoring the graphics context state.

methods.name: DrawTiledBox
methods.description: Draws a tiled pattern within a specified rectangle area.

methods.name: DrawCenterPoint
methods.description: Draws a small red ellipse at the center of the standard box, indicating the midpoint.

methods.name: DrawAlignmentGrid
methods.description: Draws a grid in the box for alignment purposes, optionally highlighting horizontal and vertical lines.

methods.name: DrawNotSupportedFeature
methods.description: Draws a message indicating that a particular feature is not supported in the current implementation.

methods.name: HelloWorldFactory
methods.description: Creates a sample PDF document with 'Hello World' or custom message, optionally in Unicode.

methods.name: GfxForLastPage
methods.description: Returns an XGraphics object for the last page of a given PDF document.
